token_policy: Link to source instead of copying long docs.
One-line descriptions; examples only where non-obvious.

skills.name: Init
skills.trigger: user asks to initialize or document codebase
skills.desc: Generate CLAUDE.md with codebase architecture, conventions, commands

skills.name: Review
skills.trigger: user asks to review PR or branch
skills.desc: Multi-pass PR review; checks logic, style, security, tests

skills.name: Security Review
skills.trigger: user asks security audit of current branch changes
skills.desc: OWASP-focused audit of pending diffs; outputs risk-ranked findings

skills.name: Simplify
skills.trigger: user asks to clean up or refactor changed code
skills.desc: Review changed code for reuse/quality/efficiency, then fix issues

skills.name: Session Start Hook
skills.trigger: user wants test/lint runners on session start (web Claude Code)
skills.desc: Create SessionStart hook ensuring project can run tests and linters

skills.name: Update Config
skills.trigger: automated behavior requests ("when X", "allow Y", "set Z=val")
skills.desc: Configure settings.json; handles hooks, permissions, env vars

skills.name: Keybindings Help
skills.trigger: user wants to remap keys or add chord shortcuts
skills.desc: Customize ~/.claude/keybindings.json; supports chord bindings

skills.name: Fewer Permission Prompts
skills.trigger: user wants fewer permission dialogs
skills.desc: Scan transcripts → add bash/MCP allowlist to .claude/settings.json

skills.name: Loop
skills.trigger: user wants recurring task
skills.desc: Run prompt or slash command on recurring interval (default 10m)

skills.name: Claude API
skills.trigger: code imports anthropic SDK; user asks about Claude API features
skills.desc: Build/debug Claude API apps; prompt caching, tool use, model migration

skills.name: Deep Research
skills.trigger: user wants multi-source fact-checked research report
skills.desc: Fan-out web searches, fetch sources, adversarially verify, synthesize cited report

skills.name: Ultra Review
skills.trigger: user says ultrareview or wants multi-agent review
skills.desc: Parallel multi-agent cloud code review; no-arg=local branch, arg=GitHub PR

skills.name: Ultra Plan
skills.trigger: user wants cloud environment for complex planning
skills.desc: Auto-create cloud worktrees/environments for multi-agent planning tasks

skills.name: Team Onboarding
skills.trigger: user wants teammate ramp-up guide
skills.desc: Generate onboarding guide from local Claude Code usage history/data

skills.name: Effort
skills.trigger: user wants to adjust effort/quality level
skills.desc: Interactive slider for session effort level (also: CLAUDE_EFFORT env var)

skills.name: Power Up
skills.trigger: user wants feature demos or to learn Claude Code features
skills.desc: Interactive animated feature demos with lessons

skills.name: TUI
skills.trigger: rendering looks flickery or user wants full-screen mode
skills.desc: Switch to flicker-free alt-screen TUI rendering

skills.name: Focus
skills.trigger: user wants compact view of conversation
skills.desc: Toggle focus view: prompt + tool summary + final response only

skills.name: Undo
skills.trigger: user wants to undo last action
skills.desc: Alias for /rewind; undoes last assistant action

skills.name: Usage
skills.trigger: user asks about token or cost statistics
skills.desc: Show token usage and cost stats (merged /cost + /stats)

skills.name: Theme
skills.trigger: user wants to change or create visual theme
skills.desc: Create or switch custom color themes

skills.name: Color
skills.trigger: user wants a session color
skills.desc: Set random session color (no args = random pick)

skills.name: Change Directory
skills.trigger: user wants to move session to different directory
skills.desc: Move session to new directory without breaking prompt cache

skills.name: Plugin List
skills.trigger: user wants to see installed plugins
skills.desc: List marketplace plugins with optional enabled/disabled filter

skills.name: Workflows
skills.trigger: user wants to manage or view workflows
skills.desc: Open workflows panel; available during in-progress turns

skills.name: Voice
skills.trigger: user wants voice mode
skills.desc: Toggle voice input/output mode

skills.name: Run
skills.trigger: user wants to run or start the app
skills.desc: Launch and drive project app to verify changes in real environment

skills.name: Verify
skills.trigger: user wants to verify a change works
skills.desc: Run app and observe behavior to confirm fix or feature works

skills.name: Code Review
skills.trigger: user asks for code review at specified effort level
skills.desc: Review diff for correctness bugs and cleanups; post inline comments or auto-fix
